title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans
goal: Reproduce and surpass Complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset1 awake versus loss-of-responsiveness prediction under leave-one-subject-out evaluation over all 19 original participants. Reproduce the source random forest on the original18 integration/segregation features and compare candidates on identical source observations, state labels, windows, training selections and evaluation folds, retaining required source controls and companion ROC AUC. Reproduction and improvement are independent first-class outcomes; neither is currently qualified.
primary_outputs: Complete Figure 5b,c Dataset1 mean participant balanced accuracy, with original ROC AUC/curve and source controls retained
Complete original granular predictions/metrics and source companion controls, with authenticated support and derivation provenance.
Separate reproduction and improvement outputs for each matched source-assistance condition; all results remain unknown.

Original static integration, segregation and ISD state contrasts in Datasets3–5 remain separately named biological reproduction. Dataset2 transfer and transition-only prediction are separate original endpoints, not easier substitutes and not universal extra prerequisites for the selected complete Dataset1 panel.
success_criteria: Reproduce the complete selected source endpoint under its original observations, sampling protocol, metric and aggregation; use the explicit new reproduction contract and an independently justified agreement criterion.
Exceed the actual strongest relevant original paper comparator on that same endpoint using the explicit new improvement contract; the original paper target cannot be lowered to a weaker replay.
Preserve complete declared support and all companions; no favorable subset, new target/split, biological effect-size optimization or scalar substituted for a source vector.
Keep paper+data and paper+data+official-code outcomes separate with identical common inputs/evaluation and recorded assistance; source code is the intended information difference.
No source-only construction, generated control, author calibration or metadata agreement is a qualified AI scientific outcome.

data_contract.neural: Participant-level regional BOLD time series, both with and without global-signal regression; publisher specifies dimensions and condition columns.
data_contract.labels: Dataset3 columns baseline/light/deep/recovery; Dataset4 baseline/light/surgical; Dataset5 N1/N2/N3/awake. These labels make state comparisons possible without figure values.
data_contract.split: Within-person state contrast; hold out complete participants/cohorts for predictive extensions. No random overlapping-window splits.
data_contract.controls: Matched GSR/noGSR inputs required by the original metric; compare motion/global-amplitude and simpler correlation strength, surrogate time series preserving autocorrelation.
data_contract.time_alignment: Static state metric initially avoids unknown transition-event timing. Sliding-window transition claims require exact TR and responsiveness annotation audit.
